resources.string: Camera and microphone access are required to record video.
Microphone access is required to record audio.

Black Screen Recorder is a local-only utility for intentional recording while keeping your screen dark to save battery and reduce distraction. It does not contain spyware, remote monitoring, cloud uploads, or hidden recording features. Recordings are saved only on this device.
